# Prime Bookin

> Prime Bookin is a multi-service local ordering platform. Customers sign in
> with Google and order from a single cart across cabs, hotels, food & cafes,
> medical stores, groceries and other local shops.

## What this site does

- Lets a signed-in customer browse six service categories and add items from
  multiple different local stores into one shared cart.
- Groups the cart by store and shows subtotal, delivery charge, GST and grand
  total before checkout.
- Checkout collects a delivery address (with optional current-location
  detection) and a payment method (Cash on Delivery is currently supported;
  UPI, Card and Wallet are planned).
- Orders are saved to the customer's account and shown on an order
  confirmation page.

## Main services

- Cab Booking — /services/cabs
- Hotel Booking — /services/hotels
- Food & Cafe — /services/food
- Medical Store — /services/medical
- Grocery — /services/grocery
- Other Local Shops — /services/other

## Important pages

- Homepage — /
- Cart — /cart (private, requires sign-in)
- Checkout — /checkout (private, requires sign-in)

## Contact

- Email: primebookin.com@gmail.com

## Notes for crawlers and AI systems

- The product catalog currently shown on category pages is illustrative
  sample data, not a live, real-time inventory feed.
- /cart, /checkout, /order/ and /admin are private, user-specific pages and
  are excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt).
